tags.reasoning: This final pericope stands as an epilogue to the entire book of Kings, offering a glimmer of hope that the Davidic covenant is not entirely void despite the destruction of the Temple. Proposed by: Burke O. Long, 2 Kings, 1991.

tags.label: Jehoiachin's release as a type of the future restoration of the Davidic line or the resurrection of Christ
tags.reasoning: The liberation and exaltation of Jehoiachin by the Babylonian king is seen by some interpreters as a faint, historical foreshadowing of the eventual restoration of the Davidic dynasty or, in Christian typology, of the resurrection and exaltation of Christ. Proposed by: Iain Provan, 1 and 2 Kings (New International Biblical Commentary), 1995.
